meta.name: Pactset pavilion recovery
meta.description: An original Pactset event-operations system informed by Integrated Biosciences pacing, hierarchy, and single-object storytelling.

secondary.role: dark-theme action and Testnet path signal

neutral.usage: deep-charcoal scenes, silver structure, pearl daylight, readable operational surfaces

surface.elevated: solid dense surface inside restrained glass frame

color.contrast_strategy: high-contrast editorial text over theme-specific scene treatments; dense solid surfaces for financial detail

typography.font_style_notes: Wide humanist grotesk; typography carries the composition, with compact tabular numerals for finance.

spacing.content_density: spacious landing, comfortable operational screens, compact finance
spacing.section_rhythm: full-viewport story beats alternating with dense role-specific work surfaces

layout.grid_system: asymmetric editorial grid with 1380px landing frame and 1120px workspace frame

shape.border_usage: subtle 1px silver boundaries; glass reserved for navigation and context

elevation.depth_cues: overlap, real scene lighting, reflective floor, restrained blur

motion.entrance_pattern: venue eases from 92% scale while HTML actions are immediately available
motion.exit_pattern: opacity and color only; no blocking outro

components.button_style: tactile solid primary or quiet underlined secondary with directional icon
components.input_style: solid readable surface, visible labels and focus
components.card_style: operational surfaces are solid; glass frames context only
components.navigation_pattern: compact floating header plus complete authenticated role shell
components.modal_style: dense glass frame with trapped focus and solid choices
components.list_style: ruled records with explicit state and next action
components.component_notes: Financial controls do not move away from the pointer; hover is enhancement only.

aesthetic.visual_metaphor: an illuminated event pavilion assembling many commitments into one structure

visual_language.visual_weight_distribution: large type balanced by one substantial venue
visual_language.focal_strategy: single hero element with progressive reveal

composition.flow_direction: vertical narrative with lateral object depth
composition.grouping_strategy: rules and shared alignment rather than repeated card grids
composition.negative_space_role: holds focus on the evolving pavilion and next action

imagery.photo_treatment: static scenery only as reduced-motion fallback
imagery.graphic_elements: numbered rules and restrained transaction path

brand_voice_in_ui.empty_state_approach: explain prerequisite and one next step

overview.fallback_strategy: theme-specific static pavilion on reduced motion, data saving, or WebGL failure

3d_elements.description: Glass-and-metal event pavilion whose equipment assembles through the story

params.renderer: WebGLRenderer, ACES tone mapping, capped DPR
params.lighting: warm point and spot spill, daylight hemisphere, silver edge light
params.camera: 36° perspective with restrained pointer parallax and portrait targets
params.materials: physical glass, brushed metal, warm translucent wall, reflective floor
params.geometry: tube arches, glass roof, mullions, stage, tables, equipment cases
params.interaction_model: intersection-observed story stages plus pointer depth

scroll_triggered_animations.animation_type: camera shift and physical dependency assembly
scroll_triggered_animations.scrub_behavior: discrete stage interpolation, no scroll hijack

scroll_morphing.description: equipment moves from perimeter to booked positions; final payment path appears

cursor_effects.description: subtle camera response over the scene

visual_effects.composite_notes: The scene is the only heavy visual layer. GSAP was evaluated but not added: existing direct Three.js interpolation and IntersectionObserver satisfy this bounded checkpoint with less runtime weight.
